summary:
Ag Root is an intelligent astronaut health assessment platform that transforms health data and interactive tests into actionable medical insights, helping protect astronaut well-being and maintain mission readiness throughout space exploration.
That is the central idea everything in the project should communicate: 
We don't just monitor astronauts. We assess their health, understand how it changes, and help predict when something needs attention.
details:
### Ag Root – Project description

Ag Root is a software-based astronaut health assessment and monitoring platform developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It aims to address the physical, cognitive, and psychological challenges astronauts face during space missions, including cardiovascular deconditioning, muscle and bone loss, cognitive changes, psychological stress, and sleep disruption.

The platform combines interactive health assessments, gamified testing, AI-assisted analysis, and a centralized medical dashboard to provide a comprehensive picture of astronaut health.

Ag Root evaluates five main health domains:

* Cardiovascular Health: Evaluating heart performance and cardiovascular responses.

* Musculoskeletal Health: Assessing muscle strength, endurance, and physical performance.

* Cognitive Health: Testing reaction time, memory, attention, and concentration.

* Psychological Health: Evaluating stress, mood, and psychological well-being.

* Sleep Health: Tracking sleep quality, duration, and fatigue.

The system works through a continuous cycle of data collection, interactive assessment, AI-assisted analysis, health visualization, and medical decision support. It compares assessment results over time to identify unusual changes, potential health deterioration, and areas requiring further evaluation.

### What Makes Ag Root Different?

Instead of relying solely on passive health monitoring and traditional questionnaires, Ag Root introduces gamified, performance-based assessments that make health evaluation more interactive and engaging while generating measurable results.

### Expected Impact

* Earlier Risk Detection: Identifying potential health deterioration through continuous assessment and individual health comparisons.

* Improved Mission Readiness: Helping medical teams make better-informed decisions about astronaut health, performance, and mission safety.

### Future Vision

Ag Root aims to expand through wearable device integration, personalized health baselines, predictive health analytics, advanced assessment simulations, and improved remote medical collaboration.

The Core Vision:

Ag Root goes beyond monitoring astronaut health. It assesses physical and cognitive performance, tracks changes over time, identifies potential risks, and transforms health data into actionable medical insights to help protect astronauts and support safer, more successful space missions.
